title: Microsoft Teams: Conditional Access policies for selected meetings
summary: The briefing passes: its configuration paths, API calls and PowerShell settings are supported by Microsoft documentation. It accurately distinguishes the roadmap target from the later Message Center schedule, flags the settings' current no-effect warning, and leaves feature-specific licensing and client coverage unresolved.

claims.claim: Microsoft plans granular Conditional Access policies for selected Teams meetings to check participants' security requirements before joining.
claims.quote: Administrators can apply Conditional Access policies to selected meetings, helping ensure participants meet organizational security requirements before joining.

claims.claim: Set-CsTeamsMeetingConfiguration -Identity Global -PublishedEntraAuthenticationContexts <contexts> publishes the meeting contexts through the MicrosoftTeams module.
claims.quote:
Set-CsTeamsMeetingConfiguration
    [[-Identity] <XdsIdentity>]
    [-PublishedEntraAuthenticationContexts <PSObject>]
The only valid input is Global
A list of authentication contexts from Microsoft Entra ID that can be applied to Teams meetings for conditional access scenarios.
